services.title: Undiagnosed No More: invisible illness check
services.description: Scores the chart with the Long COVID, chronic fatigue (ME/CFS), fibromyalgia, endometriosis, Lyme disease, lupus, migraine, depression, and anxiety models and returns a card when a condition is in the High or Elevated band, plus one information card naming any condition it could not score. Research decision support; not a diagnosis. Synthetic-data prototype: the service does not authenticate callers.
services.usageRequirements: Read access to the patient's Condition, Encounter, Observation, MedicationRequest, and Procedure resources.
